filament_notes:
CC3D TPU 98A 340M, skin color, 1.75mm. Creality Ender-3 Pro (BOWDEN).

Vendor sheet: nozzle 195-215C, bed 0-60C.

=== calibrated 2026-09-15 on CC3D TPU 98A, Ender 3 Pro ===
nozzle_temperature            205   CHOSEN 2026-09-15 <- 200 measured dramatically cleaner
                                              than 215 on the retraction tower, but the part is
                                              squeezed repeatedly and layer adhesion falls with
                                              temperature. 205 splits the difference: keeps most
                                              of the stringing win, buys back some bond strength.
                                      (measured) 200 clean / 215 heavy stringing 2026-09-14 <- temp tower 225-195C: every band
                                              printed equally well, no sag on any ramp. Orca's
                                              rule for a uniformly good range is take the middle
                                              (210), or the HIGH end when printing at raised flow
                                              rates - which we are. 215 is also the vendor ceiling.
filament_flow_ratio           1.10  MEASURED 2026-09-14 <- flow staircase, step 5 of 6.
                                              115% was rejected as over-extruded, so the
                                              optimum is bracketed, not clipped by the range.
filament_max_volumetric_speed 5.5   MEASURED 2026-09-15 <- max flow tower swept 2.0-7.0 mm3/s
                                              and never degraded, so the extruder keeps up to at
                                              least 7. Set to 5.5 for margin. Checked the test was
                                              capable of proving it: at 500 mm/s2 a 39mm part
                                              reaches 140 mm/s, and 7 mm3/s only needs 83 mm/s.
filament_retraction_length    4.0   MEASURED 2026-09-15 <- anti-string tower, band 4 of 6.
                                              Shortest band with a clean gap.
                                              2.5 is a sane Bowden-TPU START so the temp
                                              tower is readable; the machine default 4mm
                                              is a PLA value and makes TPU string badly.
pressure advance                    SKIP     <- stock Creality 4.2.2 Marlin has LIN_ADVANCE off

Values above are generic/vendor starting points, NOT measured. Do not trust
estimates from these until the PENDING lines are replaced with real numbers.

filament_density 1.21 g/cm3 is the generic polyester-TPU figure, not a CC3D
published spec. It only scales the 'filament used [g]' estimate. Weigh a
printed part and correct it if the gram numbers matter to you.
filament_cost 25 is a placeholder - set your actual spool price.

Anti-stringing set, validated 2026-09-15 by printing the same retraction tower
twice. Left/old: 215C, travel 80, z-hop 0.4, wipe on -> the gap filled with a
solid curtain. Right/new: 200C, travel 150, z-hop off, wipe off -> mostly clear.
Four changes at once, so no attribution between them; the combination is what
was tested and what should be kept together.
travel_speed lives in run.sh/calibrate.sh, not here.
